This directory is a snapshot of the playable static site: room HTML,
css/styles.css, js/, images/, sound/, fonts/. Flash SWF, CodeKit configs,
CNAME, and the upstream README are left behind.

GifOS does not rewrite the rooms. The shell (index.html + app.js) loads the
original scripts in order, serves room HTML from a packed map instead of a
network get, remaps picture and sound paths onto packed bytes, and keeps
inventory / room progress in this copy of the app. SoundManager 2 is HTML5
only (no Flash). Google Analytics from the original index is not shipped.

Do not edit vendor files to “fix” the game; wrap in app.js instead.
Rebuild with: node apps/the-house/build.mjs
